zh.d:
本版单机端只有一处改动：企业成员在首页看到的场景卡片。其余变化集中在企业版。

【修复】
· 企业场景面板不再遮住输入框。它原本挂在输入框下边缘的一颗小药丸上、向上弹出，正好盖住用户要打字的地方；现在改成输入框下方常驻的卡片网格，位于正常文档流中，结构上不可能浮起来遮挡任何东西
· 场景卡片此前没有背景也没有边框，看上去像散落在页面上的文字。原因是两个 CSS 类名在项目里根本不存在，计算值一直是全透明

本版把管理后台逐页对齐了竞品，并补上了此前缺失的最后一块：接入企业自己的存储。

【新增】
· 文件管理：接入企业自己的存储并浏览内容。兼容 S3 协议的对象存储（自建 MinIO / Ceph，或阿里云 OSS、腾讯云 COS、华为云 OBS、七牛等公有云）都能用，选一下预设就会自动填好 Endpoint 与寻址方式；企业内网 NAS 通过 WebDAV 接入，群晖 / 威联通 / TrueNAS / Windows Server 勾一个开关即可。访问密钥只写不读，存储后不再回显，浏览被限制在配置的前缀之内
· API 资产可以手工创建，不再只能导入接口文档：资产编码、分类、工具前缀、基础 URL、认证方式与认证配置、启用状态、描述。没有接口文档的服务也能登记，随后在资产内逐条声明接口操作，发布出去的技能里就会带上真实可调用的接口
· 记忆授权独立成页：一眼看清全企业哪些成员或部门对哪个记忆集合有只读或读写权限，可直接撤销。此前只能逐个集合打开抽屉查看
· 技能、工具 (MCP)、数字员工、项目组成为一级入口。它们的能力一直都在，只是埋在二级标签页里，按名字找不到
· 记忆集合新增概览统计与作用域筛选，并显示近期提炼记录（合并了多少、裁剪了多少）
· 审批中心新增总数、待审批、已通过、已拒绝四项统计，以及按五类审批类型筛选
· 配置项新增统计卡、导入模板下载与逐集合导出，导出时敏感值自动脱敏
· 首页新增进阶配置向导，把开局要做的事串成引导流程

【优化改进】
· IM 管道从「企业设置」移到「资源管理」，与模型、技能、工具放在一起
· 全部后台页面统一标题样式，标题与侧边栏取自同一处文案，不会再各写各的
· 操作审计页信息呈现优化

【修复】
· 记忆提炼的运行记录此前只写不读：每次合并与裁剪都记进了数据库，但没有任何接口能查回来，界面上只能弹一个转瞬即逝的提示。现在概览里的「本周合并 / 本周裁剪」和「近期提炼记录」都是真实数据
· 编辑资产时留空的字段会被存成空字符串而不是「未设置」，导致「工具前缀留空则沿用资产编码」这条规则失效
· 手工创建的资产被错标成「OpenAPI 3.x」
· 创建或保存失败时，提示框显示的是未翻译的原始文案标识
· 配置项的导入模板自身无法回环——模板里的字段说明行会被当成一条配置导入
· 「已生成技能：{name}」这类提示中的占位符没有被替换，13 种语言全部受影响；站内消息未读数的占位符此前只修了中英文，其余 11 种语言一直显示原始占位符
· 账单管理页的文案此前全部硬编码中文，且加载失败时会把接口原始报文直接弹给用户
· 提炼记录在其记忆集合被删除后显示一串内部标识

en.d:
One change on the desktop side this release: the scene cards enterprise members see on the home screen. Everything else is in the Enterprise edition.

[Fixed]
· The enterprise scene panel no longer covers the composer. It hung off a small pill on the composer's bottom edge and opened upward, directly over the box you were about to type in. It is now a standing card grid below the input, in normal flow, where it cannot float over anything
· Scene cards had no background and no border, so they read as text scattered on the page. Two of their CSS class names did not exist in the project and had always resolved to transparent

This release brings the admin console in line with the reference product page by page, and closes the last thing it was missing: connecting the company's own storage.

[New]
· File management: connect your own storage and browse it. Any S3-compatible object store works — self-hosted MinIO or Ceph, or Alibaba OSS, Tencent COS, Huawei OBS, Qiniu — and a preset fills in the endpoint and addressing style for you. An on-premise NAS connects over WebDAV, which Synology, QNAP, TrueNAS and Windows Server all expose with a single switch. Access secrets are write-only and never shown again once stored, and browsing is confined to the configured prefix
· API assets can be written by hand rather than only imported from a document: asset code, category, tool prefix, base URL, authentication method and configuration, enabled state, description. A service with no published document can be registered and then given its operations one by one, so the published skill carries endpoints an agent can actually call
· Memory grants get their own page: who — member or department — can read or write which memory collection, across the whole company, revocable in place. Previously this meant opening each collection's drawer in turn
· Skills, MCP tools, digital employees and project groups are now top-level entries. The capabilities were always there, buried in second-level tabs where nobody could find them by name
· Memory collections gain overview figures, a scope filter, and the recent distillation runs behind them
· The approval centre gains total / pending / approved / rejected counts and a filter over the five approval kinds
· Config sets gain overview figures, a downloadable import template, and per-set export with sensitive values masked
· The home screen gains a guided advanced-setup journey

[Improved]
· IM channels moved from Enterprise settings into Resources, alongside models, skills and tools
· Every console page now carries the same page header, titled from the same string the sidebar uses, so the two cannot drift apart
· Clearer presentation on the audit log page

[Fixed]
· The memory distillation ledger was write-only: every merge and trim had been recorded, but nothing could read it back, so the console could only show a toast that vanished. This week's merged and trimmed counts, and the recent runs, are now real rows
· Clearing a field while editing an asset stored an empty string rather than "unset", which defeated the rule that an empty tool prefix falls back to the asset code
· A hand-written asset was labelled "OpenAPI 3.x"
· A failed create or save showed an untranslated internal string identifier in the toast
· The config-set import template could not be re-imported — its own column-description line was read as a config entry
· Placeholders in messages such as "Skill generated: {name}" were never substituted, in all 13 languages; the unread-notifications count had been fixed only in Chinese and English, leaving the other 11 showing the raw placeholder
· The billing page had every string hardcoded in Chinese and, on a failed load, showed the raw API envelope to the user
· A distillation record showed an internal identifier once its memory collection was deleted
